sanskrit: ā tvāgan rāṣṭraṃ saha varcasod ihi prāṅ viśāṃ patir ekarāṭ tvaṃ vi rāja | sarvās tvā rājan pradiśo hvayantu- -upasadyo namasyo bhaveha ||
english: The kingdom has come to you together with lustre; advance eastward as lord of the clans, sole sovereign — reign widely! May all the regions summon you, O king; be here one worthy of approach, worthy of homage.

sanskrit: tvāṃ viśo vṛṇataṃ rājyāya tvām imāḥ pradiśaḥ pañca devīḥ | varṣman rāṣṭrasya kakudi śrayasva- -ato vasūni vi bhajāsy ugraḥ ||
english: May the clans choose you for kingship; may these five divine regions choose you. Ascend to the crest, the crown of the kingdom; from there, O mighty one, distribute the good things.

sanskrit: accha tvā yantu havinaḥ sajātā agnir dūto ajiraḥ santurātiḥ | jāyāḥ putrāḥ sumanaso bhavantu bahuṃ baliṃ prati paśyāsā ugraḥ ||
english: Let those of common birth who bear oblations come toward you; Agni, the swift messenger, shall keep away hostility. May your wives and sons be well-disposed; O mighty one, may you behold abundant tribute.

sanskrit: aśvinā tvāgre mitrāvaruṇobhā viśve devā marutas tvā hvayantu | sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭhā iha syāḥ sve kṣetre saviteva vi rāja ||
english: The two Aśvins shall precede you, both Mitra and Varuṇa, the Viśve Devās, the Maruts — all shall summon you. May you stand paramount among those of common birth; in your own domain reign wide as Savitṛ.

sanskrit: ā pra drava paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ śive te dyāvāpṛthivī abhūtām | tad ayaṃ rājā varuṇas tathāha sa tvāyam ahvat sa ihedam ehi ||
english: Run forward from the uttermost distance; Heaven and Earth have become propitious for you. Thus has king Varuṇa spoken — he has summoned you; he calls you hither: come here now.

sanskrit: indrendraṃ manuṣyaḥ parehi saṃ yajñiyās tvā varuṇena saṃvidānaḥ | sa tvāyam ahvat sve sadhasthe sa devān yakṣat sa u kalpayād viśaḥ ||
english: Go forth, O mortal, to Indra the Indra — the worshipful one, in accord with Varuṇa, summons you. He has called you to his own station; may he worship the gods and duly set the clans in order.

sanskrit: pathyā revatīr bahudhā virūpāḥ sarvāḥ saṅgatya varivas te akran | tās tvā sarvāḥ saṃvidānā hvayantu daśamīm ugraḥ sumanā vaśeha ||
english: The prosperous pathways, manifold and varied in form, all assembling together, have made space for you. May all of them, in full accord, summon you here to the tenth station, O mighty one, be of good will and of your own choosing.

sanskrit: yad ajireṇa haviṣā- -ava tvā gamayāmasi | atrāta indraḥ kevalīr viśo balihṛtas karat ||
english: When with swift oblation we cause you to depart — here, then, may Indra make the clans, each one exclusively, tribute-bearing.

sanskrit: hariṇasya raghuṣyado 'dhi śīrṣaṇi bheṣajam | sukṣetriyaṃ viṣāṇayād visūcīnam anīnaśat ||
english: The remedy upon the head of the swift-rushing antelope — it has made that which is well-suited for hereditary disease fade away, having utterly destroyed the spreading sickness.

sanskrit: anu tvā hariṇo vṛṣā padbhiś caturbhir akramīt | viṣāṇe vi ṣya guṣpitaṃ yat kiṃ ca kṣetriyaṃ hṛdi ||
english: The antelope-bull has stridden over you with all four hooves. O horn, release and scatter whatever hereditary malady is pent up in the heart.

sanskrit: ado yad avarocate catuṣpakṣam iva cchadiḥ | tena te sarvaṃ kṣetriyam aṅgebhyo nāśayāmasi ||
english: That which shines yonder like a four-sided roof — with that we destroy all your hereditary disease from your limbs.

sanskrit: ud agātāṃ bhagavatī vicṛtau nāma tārake | vi kṣetriyasya muñcatām adhamaṃ pāśam uttamam ||
english: The two auspicious stars named Vicṛtau have risen; may they loose the hereditary disease — its lowest snare and its highest.

sanskrit: yad āsuteḥ kriyamāṇāyāḥ kṣetriyaṃ tvā vyānaśe | vedāhaṃ tasya bheṣajaṃ kṣetriyaṃ nāśayāmi te ||
english: The hereditary disease that has pervaded you from the pressing rite being performed — I know its remedy; I destroy the hereditary disease for you.

sanskrit: apavāse nakṣatrāṇām apavāsa utoṣasām | apāsmat sarvam āmayad apa kṣetriyam akramīt ||
english: At the setting of the asterisms, at the setting also of the dawns — all sickness has departed from us; the hereditary malady has withdrawn.

sanskrit: āpa id vā u bheṣajīr āpo amīvacātanīḥ | āpo viśvasya bheṣajīs tās tvā muñcantu kṣetriyāt ||
english: The waters are indeed the healers; the waters are the chasers of disease. The waters are the remedy for all — may they release you from the hereditary disease.

sanskrit: pumān puṃsaḥ parijāto 'śvatthaḥ khadirād adhi | sa hantu śatrūn māmakān yāṃś cāhaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām ||
english: The Aśvattha tree, a male born from a male, has sprung forth atop the Khadira tree. Let it smite my enemies — those whom I hate and those who hate me.

sanskrit: tān aśvattha niḥ śṛṇīhi śatrūn vaibādha dodhataḥ | indreṇa vṛtraghnā mehy agninā varuṇena ca ||
english: O Aśvattha, crush those enemies, the harassers who rage repeatedly. Come to me with Indra the Vṛtra-slayer, with Agni and with Varuṇa.

sanskrit: yathāśvattha niḥśṛṇāsi pūrvān jātān utāparān | evā pṛtanyatas tvam abhi tiṣṭha sahasva ca ||
english: As you, O Aśvattha, crush those born before and those born after — so stand against and overwhelm those who battle against you.

sanskrit: yathāśvattha vibhinatsy antar mahaty arṇave | evā me śatroś cittāni viṣvag bhindhi sahasva ca ||
english: As you, O Aśvattha, split asunder within the great ocean — so split my enemy's thoughts in all directions and overwhelm them.

sanskrit: yaḥ sahamānaś carasi sāsahāna iva rṣabhaḥ | tenāśvattha tvayā vayaṃ sapatnān sahiṣīmahi ||
english: You who roam as one that overcomes, like a bull that has conquered — O Aśvattha, with you we shall overpower our rivals.

sanskrit: sinātv enān nirṛtir mṛtyoḥ pāśair amokyaiḥ | aśvattha śatrūn māmakān yāṃś cāhaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām ||
english: Let Nirṛti bind them with the inescapable nooses of Death. O Aśvattha, my enemies — those whom I hate and those who hate me.

sanskrit: adharāñcaḥ pra plavantāṃ chinnā naur iva bandhanāt | na nir bādha praṇuttānāṃ punar asti nivartanam ||
english: Let them drift downward and away, like a boat cut loose from its moorings. For those who have been driven off and expelled there is no return.

sanskrit: praiṇān nudāmi manasā pra cittena pra brahmaṇā | praiṇān vṛkṣasya śākhaya- -aśvatthasya nudāmasi ||
english: I drive them forth with mind, with intelligence, with sacred power. We drive them forth with the branch of the tree — of the Aśvattha.
